note: The master is the rest pose's own pumpkin. He has no face to move: the candle's light is his face. Speech brightens his own carved mouth's glow (glow.py writes glow_01-03, a little brighter to brightest, from the master, so the carving never changes); no blinks, no glances. The face sheet's pieces are unused: its glowing mouths are carved differently, and the tells (brighter, guttering) and a lost pot's dimmed light are whole-figure frames.
